_readme: Relay's detection benchmark. Every case is a line of sermon speech as an ASR
system would transcribe it, plus the verses that SHOULD reach the screen.
This exists because the moat was unmeasured. docs/SPEC.md sets a target of a
<5% wrong-verse rate and nothing anywhere checked it. You cannot improve what
It also runs in CI, so detection quality is a GATE and not a vibe.
THREE KINDS OF CASE, and the negatives matter most:
expect: [refs]  — these verses must be found.
expect: []      — a NEGATIVE. Nothing may fire. Most of these are real
failures pulled out of a live rehearsal: garbled speech
that made Relay put the wrong scripture on a wall.
must_not_fire   — the verse may be SUGGESTED, but must never auto-fire.
Paraphrases live here: an uncalibrated TF-IDF score is
not a probability and must never reach a congregation
ADDING CASES IS THE MOST USEFUL THING YOU CAN DO. Especially: real sermon
lines in Yorùbá, Kiswahili and Hausa, and real ASR mistakes. A case that
fails is not a problem — it is the point. See docs/LANGUAGES.md.

cases.text: Let us turn together to John chapter three verse sixteen.
Our text this morning is Romans 8:28.
Turn with me to psalm twenty three verse one.
open your bibles to sam one hundred and thirteen verse one
